originals.citation: Mireles, J. D., Cho, J.-H., & Xu, S. (2016). Extracting attack narratives from traffic datasets. International Conference on Cyber Conflict (CyCon U.S.).

quote: In this paper we explore this topic through the replication of a prior study “Extracting Attack Narratives from Traffic Datasets” by Mireles et al.
notes: The abstract's bracketed citation wrongly points to Athanasiades et al. 2003 (@athanasiades2003); the named study is Mireles et al. 2016.
